test_scope: Ordinary capture-marks handler through capture.run_capture and its store, plus the actual managed evaluation reader and evaluation.evaluate_queues. Synthetic records in disposable native PostgreSQL with isolated Unix sockets; no operational data or optimizer run.

observations.requirement: 59 分钟可成为 CLOSE；61 分钟只能记为普通观察，标准 C 计为缺失。
observations.actual: 同一已入场候选，两个独立样例在取价前均为 0/1。单独取 59 或 61 分钟的报价后各有 1 条候选 CLOSE 和 1 条 CLOSE 价格证据，均未降级；标准 C 各变为 1/1。现行普通取价未满足 61 分钟反例。

observations.requirement: 同一候选以开赛或到期前 60 分钟内观察时间最晚的一笔为收盘价；只从带新版本的登记后取价开始生效。
observations.actual: 普通取价的 candidate_marks 每个候选至多 1 条 CLOSE。两笔入窗报价分两次提交，不论先提交 59 分钟还是 1 分钟，均保留先成功提交的那笔；重复相同包幂等，第二笔不同报价报 papersim_candidate_close_conflict。两笔同包也报 FAILED，但第一笔已提交且进入覆盖。市场价格证据表没有相同的每候选唯一限制，标准 C 按 evidence_id 顺序取最后一条 CLOSE，没有按 observed_at 取最新。
observations.legacy_evidence_example: 合法的 record_scan 依次提供赛前 1 分钟的 0.82、59 分钟的 0.71，两条证据均存，评估选 0.71；再用普通取价提交赛前 20 分钟的 0.76 后，价格证据共 3 条，候选 CLOSE 标记为 1 条，评估选 0.76。

source_fields.prepared_quote_clock: prepare_capture._targets and prepare._record derive the binding from Gamma gameStartTime for domestic soccer and endDate for crypto. The sealed target has event_start_at and expires_at; prepare_inputs._resolve_target checks the market clock, MarketTarget materialization preserves expiry_at and event_start_at, scan persists the derived boundary in candidates.event_start_at.
source_fields.unprepared_pack_clock: d1compare.packbuild.events_materials derives the same sport/crypto boundary. An older candidate without a proved boundary remains unknown; missing values and unsupported sports must not be reconstructed by assumption.
source_fields.ordinary_row: store_psycopg.candidate_capture_target returns candidate_id and event_start_at only. Mark packs contain observed_at, candidate/scan reference, buy side, token, bid/ask/mid/last, source reference, and optional upstream snapshot digest. Ordinary run_capture registers the pack bytes, includes its hash in the receipt, and persists mark and eligible CLOSE evidence. The timestamp of archive registration is not independently verified provider receipt time.
source_fields.d1_quote_witness: capture._d1_quote validates condition and token, request_sequence, raw book digest and byte length, source timestamp, upstream source status, received_at, as-of cutoff, and both age limits; it reconstructs the raw buy-side quote. The sealed plan records claimed and observed prices and rejection reasons. d1compare.operations._Operation._process_capture binds mark/close rows and write times to first-write evidence, checked on replay. Optional scoring evidence returns selected CLOSE row id, price, side-filtered provenance, time and digest.
source_fields.single_close: mark_capture_upsert plus the existing partial unique index enforce one candidate CLOSE. Later independent observations may be staged as periodic marks at their own observation times; replay of the identical CLOSE is distinct from replacing it with a second observation.

managed_entry_contracts.prepared_d1: FX-40 plan-v3.md line 126 explicitly requires B0/B2 to share the original capture batch, request sequence and purchased token. Line 119 identifies independent checks on the market, decision, token, book, slot and freshness. For candidates covered by scan_preparation, _d1_capture_materials also verifies the interval digest. A distinct subsequent manifest is correctly refused. This requirement is retained.
managed_entry_contracts.direct_d1: A directly packed B1 candidate without the preparation binding can consume a later independent, pre-sealed D1 buy-side book in a registered capture slot with its original identifiers and full D1 quote checks. The existing native case uses separate B1 and B2 manifests. This covers the direct mode; changing a prepared candidate into an unprepared one is outside this result.
managed_entry_contracts.ordinary: The ordinary non-D1 capture-marks --managed interface accepts a conditional subsequent observation as its own pack after decision time and earlier than the stored boundary, persistently linking the pack. A subsequent second CLOSE is correctly refused. This path does not produce the D1 per-item manifest witness and cannot be counted as one.

native_checks.purpose: Prepared candidate and two correctly sourced batches; first registered periodic write succeeds, distinct later batch fails with the exact policy binding diagnostic and business rows remain identical.
Directly packed B1 with separate B2 public-book batch and managed capture slot; two existing normal D1 tests cover quote values, market and buy-side identity, freshness and unattributed writes.
Ordinary managed CLI writes initial periodic + later CLOSE, reopens both raw packs and mark rows, refuses a second later CLOSE and preserves the first CLOSE.

test_setup_deviations: Two preliminary pytest processes were stopped to remove the default JUnit XML reporter, which includes an automatic hostname. Both temporary XML metadata outputs were removed; final runs saved only counts and output hashes.

The first ordinary-pack probe confused the metadata-only verify_snapshot result with the full raw snapshot row. The corrected probe verifies metadata and retrieves bytes with read_snapshot. Its initial aggregate receipt is retained in visible-policy-work/ordinary-probe-before-fix.json.
